verdict.rationale: Event-triggered automation is a fair question for an analytics platform, so the axis applies. However, nothing in the evidence describes user-defined rules that fire actions automatically when events occur. The pack covers feature flags, cohorts, audience targeting, guides, data export and third-party integrations, but these are adjacent features or building blocks, not an event-rule automation capability.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can define rules that trigger actions automatically on events
